title: Germs test record sheet
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Germs and handwashing (How Do Germs Spread?)
source: Written for science/y2 lesson 10 (Germs test record sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 10: What are germs and how do they spread?. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Tiny living things
points: Germs are too small to see
Colds and tummy bugs come from germs

parts.text: Pinch of glitter on one palm
Touch a cup, a book and a spoon

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Glitter is on all three: germs spread by touch

keywords.def: a tiny living thing that can make us ill
move from one place to more places
something we use to show an idea
air bursting out of your nose and mouth

questions.q: Can we see germs with our eyes?

questions.a: Touch, coughs, sneezes, dirty food or water

questions.q: Core: Do the glitter (or flour) test with an adult. Record which objects got glitter on them.
questions.a: A record showing glitter on every object touched

questions.q: Extend: Write how glitter is like germs.
questions.a: It spreads to everything we touch, like germs do

questions.q: Stretch: How is the model different from real germs?
questions.a: Glitter can be seen; real germs cannot
B) Kill it (wash hands). Catch the sneeze in a tissue, put it in the bin, then wash hands to kill the germs.

questions.q: Big question: how can we tell where germs have been?
questions.a: Use a model like glitter to show how they spread by touch
